title: Visual Orientalism in the AI Era: From West-East Binaries to English-Language Centrism

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing AI-generated images of 12 countries using a multi-model vision-language model (VLM) ensemble to code and compare visual representations across five dimensions: political symbols, cultural symbols, flag appearance, sovereignty representation, and modernity level.

Evaluating intersectional visual orientalism by comparing the frequency of cultural symbols and modernity ratings in AI-generated images of women versus men across Eastern and Western regions using two-way ANOVA.
